declaration.negotiation_history_statement: I submit this declaration on behalf of Whitcombe Reyes LLP in support of preliminary approval. The parties exchanged written term sheets over three rounds, and the complete negotiation transcript is being filed with the motion. Our initial proposal was a $30 million class fund and $6 million in fees and expenses. Brightline countered at $26 million and $5 million, respectively. We then proposed a $28 million class fund while accepting the $5 million fee figure, and Brightline offered the final $27 million class fund, which we accepted. Fees were discussed from the first round, not only after class relief was agreed. Throughout the negotiations, both sides proposed automatic payments to identified class members, no clear-sailing provision, and payment to the class of any requested fees the court declines to award. The $5 million fee remains subject to court approval. The $27 million fund represents approximately 42% of the $64 million in disputed renewal charges. In assessing the settlement, we considered our estimate of a 55% chance of prevailing at trial and an approximately $50 million award if successful, as well as the substantial certification risk, the possibility of no recovery, and the roughly two-to-three-year wait for trial. The automatic distribution avoids a claims process despite Brightline's ability to identify the members and cards charged. In my judgment, the settlement provides meaningful, prompt class relief and warrants preliminary approval, subject to the court's independent review, notice to the class, and consideration of any objections.
